authority: CEO R320 §6 — buyer experiment decision tree

what_we_know.mechanism: Dual anti-fibrotic: CD47-mimetic glycan surface + IL-10 analog PLGA release
what_we_know.computational_evidence: IL-10 release 2468 ng/cm²/day at day 30 (24,680x above 0.1 threshold). 4/4 attacks survived.

what_we_do_NOT_know.wet_lab_validation: No physical measurement of IL-10 release in actual CSF-like conditions
what_we_do_NOT_know.glycan_stability: No measurement of glycan surface density degradation over 30 days
what_we_do_NOT_know.in_vivo_efficacy: No animal model data on fibrotic encapsulation reduction
what_we_do_NOT_know.toxicity: No measurement of IL-10 local concentration vs toxicity threshold in CSF

what_would_change_our_mind.if_IL10_release_below_threshold: Wet-lab shows IL-10 < 0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 → PLGA kinetics model wrong → switch polymer or loading
what_would_change_our_mind.if_glycan_shedding_rapid: Wet-lab shows glycan density < 1e12/cm² before day 30 → surface chemistry wrong → switch immobilization method
what_would_change_our_mind.if_fibrosis_not_reduced: Animal model shows fibrotic encapsulation rate unchanged → mechanism wrong → CEMETERY
what_would_change_our_mind.if_toxicity_exceeded: IL-10 concentration in CSF exceeds 10 µmol/cm² → dose too high → reduce loading

PASS.condition: IL-10 release >= 0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 AND glycan density >= 1e12/cm² AND total IL-10 < 10 µmol/cm²
PASS.next_experiment: Rat shunt model: P-20 coated vs uncoated catheter, 30-day implantation, measure fibrotic encapsulation

FAIL.condition: IL-10 release < 0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 OR glycan density < 1e12/cm² OR toxicity exceeded
FAIL.state_transition: EXPERIMENT_READY → REPAIR (one attempt: switch PLGA to PLA or PCL for slower/faster release)
FAIL.next_experiment: Repeat in vitro with alternative polymer
FAIL.if_repair_fails: CEMETERY — PLGA/PLA/PCL all fail to sustain IL-10 release → mechanism infeasible

AMBIGUOUS.condition: IL-10 release meets threshold for first 15 days but drops below by day 30
AMBIGUOUS.state_transition: EXPERIMENT_READY → REDESIGN loading (increase PLGA loading or use multi-layer coating)
AMBIGUOUS.next_experiment: Repeat with 2x loading or dual-layer PLGA (fast-release outer + slow-release inner)

state: EXPERIMENT_READY — computational package complete, decisive experiment fully specified, buyer decision tree defined
